standard_prerequisites.name: Representatives and perfection
standard_prerequisites.use: Perfection from a covering by strictly perfect representatives.

standard_prerequisites.name: Summands of finite free are locally free

core_obligations: (1) ⇒ (2)/(3): strictly perfect representatives are finite complexes of direct summands of finite free modules, which are finite locally free over a locally ringed space (proof line 12560-12562).

(2)/(3) ⇒ (1): finite locally free modules are locally direct summands of finite free modules, so the covering provides strictly perfect representatives and the independent-representative lemma gives perfection (proof lines 12563-12565).
proof_roadmap: Translate strictly perfect into finite locally free and back.
difficulty_reason: The equivalence follows from the independent-representative lemma together with the fact that on a locally ringed space every direct summand of a finite free module is finite locally free.
